description: This file provides inline functions for validating, converting, and manipulating BCD-encoded MCC and MNC values, as well as PLMN to MCC/MNC conversions, within the ocudu::bcd_helper namespace.

methods.name: is_valid_mcc
methods.description: Checks if a 16-bit integer is a valid BCD-encoded MCC (3 digits).

methods.name: is_valid_mcc
methods.description: Checks if a string of length 3 contains only digits, representing a valid MCC.

methods.name: is_valid_mcc
methods.description: Checks if an array of three uint8_t digits are all <= 9, representing a valid MCC.

methods.name: is_valid_mnc
methods.description: Checks if a 16-bit integer is a valid BCD-encoded MNC (2 or 3 digits).

methods.name: is_valid_mnc
methods.description: Checks if a string of length 2 or 3 contains only digits, representing a valid MNC.

methods.name: is_valid_mnc
methods.description: Checks if a span of uint8_t contains 2 or 3 digits <= 9, representing a valid MNC.

methods.name: is_valid_plmn
methods.description: Checks if a 32-bit integer representing a PLMN has its upper 8 bits zero.

methods.name: bcd_plmn_to_mcc
methods.description: Extracts the MCC from a BCD-encoded PLMN.

methods.name: bcd_plmn_to_mnc
methods.description: Extracts the MNC from a BCD-encoded PLMN.

methods.name: string_to_mcc
methods.description: Converts a 3-digit string to a BCD-encoded MCC.

methods.name: mcc_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded MCC to a string.

methods.name: bytes_to_mcc
methods.description: Converts a 3-byte array of BCD digits to a MCC.

methods.name: mcc_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a MCC to a 3-byte array of BCD digits.

methods.name: mcc_bytes_to_string
methods.description: Converts a 3-byte array of MCC BCD digits to string.

methods.name: string_to_mnc
methods.description: Converts a 2 or 3-digit string to a BCD-encoded MNC.

methods.name: mnc_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded MNC to string.

methods.name: bytes_to_mnc
methods.description: Converts a byte array of MNC digits to a MCC.

methods.name: mnc_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a MCC to a byte array of MNC digits.

methods.name: mnc_bytes_to_string
methods.description: Converts a byte array of MNC digits to string.

methods.name: ngap_plmn_to_mccmnc
methods.description: Extracts MCC and MNC from a PLMN.

methods.name: ngap_mccmnc_to_plmn
methods.description: Encodes MCC and MNC into a PLMN.

methods.name: plmn_string_to_bcd
methods.description: Converts a string representation of PLMN to BCD format.

methods.name: plmn_bcd_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded PLMN to string.
